Data sources

    Bus stops

    Swipe the stop name on the device to switch between saved stops. Tapping the bus list shows a QR code for the active stop.

    Saved stops

      Names are looked up from LTA automatically. You can rename a stop, e.g. "Home" or "Office".

      Service order

      Services listed here show first, in this order, at every stop. Others follow after. Drag to reorder.

      Display

      You can also pull down from the top of the screen on the device to change brightness and toggle dimming.

      Brightness

      --

      Changes apply as you drag.

      Auto-dim when idle

      Dims the screen when nobody has touched it for a while. The first touch only wakes it.

      Night mode

      Every day between these times, the screen can dim, switch to warm colours with no blue light, or both.

      Dim the screen

      Set to 0% to switch the backlight off at night.

      Warm night colours

      Swaps cyan and magenta for orange and hot pink on brown-black, easier on the eyes in a dark room.

      Weather

      Data from NEA via data.gov.sg.

      Notifications

      Checking...

      Apps on your network (such as Sanctuary) can push toasts, Home page banners and full-screen alerts to this screen. They need this token, sent as Authorization: Bearer <token> to /api/notify. Without a token, pushes are refused.
